summary: Frontend-only tests for iter368 unified 'Family members' UX. Verified 3 flows: Staff People > Families dialog, Staff Children edit dialog family members block, and Member Portal /portal/family. The unified section, roles/pickup toggles, portal card, and portal add/edit for approval all render correctly and portal add produces the correct 'Sent for approval' toast. HOWEVER a critical regression in UnifiedPeoplePage.jsx breaks the staff-side family-members editor as soon as the family contains any adult member: the component renders <Edit /> but the lucide-react import list on line 3 is missing the 'Edit' symbol, throwing ReferenceError caught by ErrorBoundary. This makes the reported original bug (parents not saving) still USER-VISIBLE from the staff UI even though the backend saved the row — the row never renders and re-opening the dialog crashes the members list.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: Edit is not defined. The lucide-react import on line 3 does NOT include `Edit`, but the family-member row (line 1477) and edit-guest section render `<Edit size={... } />`. As soon as the staff family dialog tries to render even one adult family member (either an existing member on open, or a newly-picked one), the map crashes and ErrorBoundary swallows the whole editor. Net effect: staff CANNOT see or manage adults on any family that has members — regression vs the very bug being fixed. Also blocks fam-member-edit-<id>, fam-member-remove-<id> and persistence verification because the row never renders after the pick.

After clicking child-member-remove-<person_id> on a linked family member, the row was still present on the next check (count=1). Could not fully verify because Edit-crash may have leaked stale state; needs main agent to re-verify DELETE /children/{child_id}/family-members/{person_id} response handling and loadChildMembers refresh.

Clicking a suggestion presumably calls POST /families/{id}/members successfully (no toast.error, no failed request seen), but the row never appears in the DOM because rendering crashes on <Edit />. Consider adding a lint rule / build-time check so a missing lucide icon import fails CI (this exact class of bug repeats).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/pages/UnifiedPeoplePage.jsx:3 — `Edit` lucide icon used at line 1477 (fam-member row) and elsewhere but not imported. This is the actual root cause of the user-reported 'parents not saving' bug on the staff side after iter368.

/app/frontend/src/pages/UnifiedPeoplePage.jsx is 2027 lines — over the 700-line guideline; the family/child/guest dialogs are tightly coupled and repeatedly re-declare form state. Splitting the family dialog + child dialog into their own components would (a) make missing-import bugs surface immediately, (b) reduce the ErrorBoundary blast radius.

PersonPicker onPick handlers duplicate the '{ name, person_id, person_type, role: Guardian, can_pickup: true }' shape in three places (child dialog line 1417, family dialog line 1497, portal). Consider a small helper to keep defaults in sync with defaultCanPickup().

rca of the issue: Root cause of the visible 'parents not saving' regression on staff UI is NOT the backend — /api/families/{id}/members POST succeeds (the previously passing test suite test_iter368_family_members.py confirms this). It is a missing named import: `Edit` is used inside the `.map` that renders each fam-member row (UnifiedPeoplePage.jsx line 1477: `<Button ... data-testid={`fam-member-edit-${m.id}`} onClick={...}><Edit size={12} /></Button>`) but `Edit` is not in the lucide-react import statement on line 3. React throws ReferenceError during render, ErrorBoundary captures it, and the whole fam-members-editor unmounts. From the user's POV the row 'disappears' after picking a person and the family 'looks empty' after reopening — indistinguishable from the original save bug. Fix: append `, Edit` to the lucide-react named-imports on line 3 of UnifiedPeoplePage.jsx.
